charge_due_status_consistent.name: charge_due_status_consistent
charge_due_status_consistent.value:
("charge_due"."status" = 'unpaid' and "charge_due"."amount_paid" = 0)
        or ("charge_due"."status" = 'partial' and "charge_due"."amount_paid" > 0 and "charge_due"."amount_paid" < "charge_due"."amount_due")
        or ("charge_due"."status" = 'paid' and "charge_due"."amount_paid" = "charge_due"."amount_due")

expense_invoice_consistent.name: expense_invoice_consistent
expense_invoice_consistent.value:
("expense"."invoice_key" is null) = ("expense"."invoice_content_type" is null)
        and ("expense"."invoice_key" is not null or "expense"."invoice_size" is null)
        and ("expense"."invoice_size" is null or "expense"."invoice_size" > 0)
